["Azazel Boss Configuration"]
	#Maximum health of Azazel
	# Default: 800.0
	# Range: 100.0 ~ 10000.0
	maxHealth = 800.0
	#Movement speed of Azazel
	# Default: 0.2
	# Range: 0.05 ~ 1.0
	movementSpeed = 0.2
	#Knockback resistance (1.0 = completely immune)
	# Default: 1.0
	# Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0
	knockbackResistance = 1.0

["Azazel Attack Damage"]
	#Damage dealt by the launch explosion attack
	# Default: 8.0
	# Range: 0.0 ~ 100.0
	launchAttackDamage = 8.0
	#Damage dealt when pulling players in
	# Default: 5.0
	# Range: 0.0 ~ 100.0
	pullAttackDamage = 5.0
	#Damage dealt by the wind knockback attack
	# Default: 5.0
	# Range: 0.0 ~ 100.0
	windAttackDamage = 5.0
	#Damage dealt per hit during the wheel dash attack
	# Default: 4.0
	# Range: 0.0 ~ 100.0
	wheelAttackDamage = 4.0

["Azazel Attack Frequencies"]
	#Chance (1 in X ticks) for Azazel to perform an active attack. Lower = faster attacks.
	# Default: 80
	# Range: 10 ~ 600
	attackChance = 80
	#Chance (1 in X ticks) to spawn minions passively while idle.
	# Default: 600
	# Range: 100 ~ 2400
	passiveSummonChance = 600

["Nether Spawner Configuration"]
	#Radius within which the spawner detects players to activate.
	# Default: 20.0
	# Range: 1.0 ~ 128.0
	playerDetectionRadius = 20.0
	#Cooldown (in ticks) for spawning Mini-Bosses (Manipulator, Guardian, Welcomer) [20 ticks = 1 second].
	# Default: 18000
	# Range: 1200 ~ 1000000
	miniBossCooldown = 18000
	#Cooldown (in ticks) for spawning Civilian NPCs (Blacksmith, Doctor, Gilded Golem, Trader).
	# Default: 72000
	# Range: 1200 ~ 1000000
	civilianNpcCooldown = 72000
	#Number of Believers spawned at once.
	# Default: 5
	# Range: 1 ~ 20
	believersSpawnCount = 5
	#The scatter radius for spawning Believers.
	# Default: 6.0
	# Range: 1.0 ~ 32.0
	believersSpawnRadius = 6.0
	#Maximum number of Believers around the spawner before it skips spawning.
	# Default: 5
	# Range: 1 ~ 50
	believersMaxNearby = 5
	#Cooldown if Believers successfully spawned.
	# Default: 72000
	# Range: 1200 ~ 1000000
	believersSuccessCooldown = 72000
	#Soft cooldown if spawning was skipped because there are too many Believers around.
	# Default: 600
	# Range: 20 ~ 72000
	believersFailCooldown = 600

["Azazel Trophy Mask Configuration"]
	#Time (in ticks) to regenerate 1 totem charge in the mask [2400 ticks = 2 minutes].
	# Default: 2400
	# Range: 200 ~ 72000
	maskRegenCooldown = 2400
	#Does wearing the Azazel Trophy mask grant fire immunity?
	maskFireImmunity = true

["Azazel Defense & Melee"]
	#Radius to trigger close-combat attacks (Launch, Midas)
	# Default: 6.0
	# Range: 1.0 ~ 20.0
	meleeAttackRadius = 6.0
	#Chance (0-100%) to perform a melee attack when a player is close
	# Default: 30
	# Range: 0 ~ 100
	meleeAttackChance = 30
	#Minimum hits required to trigger the defense shield
	# Default: 5
	# Range: 1 ~ 100
	shieldHitsMin = 5
	#Maximum hits required to trigger the defense shield
	# Default: 20
	# Range: 1 ~ 100
	shieldHitsMax = 20

["Azazel Midas Attack"]
	#Number of BossUnits spawned during Midas attack
	# Default: 3
	# Range: 0 ~ 10
	midasBossUnitCount = 3
	#Number of Guardians spawned during Midas attack
	# Default: 2
	# Range: 0 ~ 10
	midasGuardianCount = 2
	#Fire damage dealt per tick on the fire ring
	# Default: 8.0
	# Range: 0.0 ~ 100.0
	midasFireDamage = 8.0
	#Ticks required near the boss to turn an item into gold (40 = 2 seconds)
	# Default: 40
	# Range: 1 ~ 600
	midasGoldTime = 40

["Azazel Prison Attack"]
	#Radius of the blackstone prison
	# Default: 5
	# Range: 2 ~ 15
	prisonRadius = 5
	#Time in ticks before the prison breaks (200 = 10 seconds)
	# Default: 200
	# Range: 60 ~ 1200
	prisonDuration = 200
	#Maximum random height of the prison walls
	# Default: 6
	# Range: 3 ~ 15
	prisonMaxHeight = 6
note: Read-only file snapshot; class defaults and groups pinned separately in coa2-config. Not proof of a live game configuration load.
